rows.note: Use this for the pedestrian path alongside a road, rather than the road surface itself.

example.english: They’re doing work on the pavement over there, so walk more slowly.
example.traditional: 行人路嗰邊整緊路，你行慢啲。
example.jyutping: hang4 jan4 lou6 go2 bin1 zing2 gan2 lou6 nei5 haang4 maan6 di1

rows.note: Use this when referring specifically to the paved surface of a road or other thoroughfare.

example.english: The pavement is slippery, so drive carefully.
example.jyutping: lou6 min2 sap1 waat6 zaa1 ce1 jiu3 siu2 sam1

rows.note: Use this as the general ground-surface term when the area is not specifically a road or sidewalk.

example.english: This pavement has been covered with non-slip rubber, so it’s not slippery even when it rains.
example.traditional: 呢塊地面鋪咗防滑膠，落雨都唔怕。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 dei6 min2 pou1 zo2 fong4 waat6 gaau1 lok6 jyu5 dou1 m4 paa3
